name: In And Out of Insanity boosts a Cultist shield's absorb amount by the native engine multiplier (#1146)
contract: 582308 is aura 317 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_ABSORB_AMOUNT_PCT, BasePoints 19 / DieSides 1 -> value 20, matching $s1=20%, with an empty EffectSpellClassMask (HasSpellClassMask() false). AuraEffect::CalculateAmount (SpellAuraEffects.cpp ~630) already has a generic, class-gated branch: for any SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB/SPELL_AURA_MANA_SHIELD effect whose own spell is SpellFamilyName 31 cast by a CLASS_CULTIST player, it multiplies the resolved amount by GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_ABSORB_AMOUNT_PCT, ...). This is a different calculation stage from SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (spell_effect_value would not see it), so the scenario casts a real Cultist shield and reads its applied aura_amount. Void Shield rank 502244 (SpellFamilyName 31, SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB, EffectMiscValue 127) has SpellLevel/BaseLevel 20, EffectBonusMultiplier 0 (no spell-power term for this rank) and EffectBasePoints 240 / EffectDieSides 10, so at caster level 20 (zeroing the 3.5/level term the same way 560002 does) its raw absorb amount is bounded to the DBC-verified range [241, 250] before any percentage boost, and the boosted amount is bounded to [floor(241*1.2), floor(250*1.2)] = [289, 300]. Two independent casts roll independently, so the ratio window [1.15, 1.25] is a true bound covering every combination of the two rolls, not a probabilistic guess -- the same technique the README documents for Arm of Thorim's dice-bounded 20% bonus.

steps.label: Shield before the talent is known
The shield lands and its raw absorb amount is inside the DBC-bounded range
Let Wracked Mind (502244's own EffectTriggerSpell[2]=805801, ExcludeTargetAuraSpell=805801, SpellDuration 8 = 15000ms no-reshield debuff) expire before recasting, not just the GCD
Refresh the shield with the talent known
In And Out of Insanity boosts the refreshed shield by 20%, within the dice-bounded window
